_comment: The Smush animation player (AnimPlay.c of lecsmush/insane, 2026-11-14) and the light editor's set. AnimPlayer is the 0x70-byte player record anm_Start allocates (build/overrides_mixer_misc.c describes it as AnimPlay; the Ghidra name differs so the two do not clash): its two timers, frame / sync pacing, the decoder state anm_animator_Initialize resets and anm_animator_NewAnim fills, the streamer handle and the step result. g_pLightEdSet is the set the light editor (LightEd_*) works on.

structs.name: AnimPlayer
structs.comment: A Smush animation player (0x70 bytes, anm_Start).
fields: timer id of the clock timer
timer id of the frame timer
set when the player gave up
set by the frame timer: a frame must be shown
normal frame delay in timer ticks (1193180 / fps)
current frame delay (kept in sync with the sound)
result of the last frame step: < 0 error, 1 finished, 5 first step
